title: Ruleset hardening: promote 5 rules from Warning to Error
summary: Five AL analysis rules were promoted from Warning to Error severity in the ruleset by removing their overrides and resolving all violations. The fixes included adding missing codeunit to a permission set, removing an invalid hidden group on a page, and documenting suppressions for published events and test library assertions.
key_points: Promotes five rules (AL0547, AL0679, AW0014, AS0058, PTE0007) from Warning to Error
Resolves all violations for promoted rules through code fixes or pragma suppressions
Adds missing Email Logging Install codeunit to Email Logging permission set
Removes hidden F&unctions group causing unreachable action on Account Schedule Names page
Defers remediation for seven other rules requiring broader changes or domain input
